name: Minimum contiguous area
source_accuracy_basis: Parcel geometry; LINZ NZ Primary Land Parcels nominal accuracy 1-100 m rural. Area is measured on the polygon as published

name: Minimum usable width
threshold: 180 m inward-buffer core; 2A/P published as audit comparator only
source_accuracy_basis: As S-01; the inward-buffer core is measured on the same geometry

name: Usable land cover
source_accuracy_basis: LCDB v5.0 class attribute; no positional test, so no accuracy band applies

name: Outside public conservation land
source: LINZ Protected Areas (53564) with the Protected Area / Parcel association table (3561)
threshold: Parcel identity against table 3561 where the protected area is defined from parcels; for protected areas with no association row, overlap area above source_accuracy.conservation_overlay_m x boundary length; s04_basis records which decided
source_accuracy_basis: Identity against LINZ table 3561 where a protected area is defined from parcels ('boundaries for most protected areas are derived from the Landonline Primary Parcel(s)'); geometry only for areas with no association row, against siting.source_accuracy.conservation_overlay_m = 0.5 m

name: Highly productive land flag
source: NPS-HPL 2022 amended Dec 2025; NZLRI Land Use Capability 2021
threshold: hpl_fraction (share of the unit mapped LUC 1/2/3) above that unit's own luc_noise_band = source_accuracy.luc_overlay_m x perimeter / area; both published
source_accuracy_basis: NZLRI LUC 2021 is 1973-79 mapping at 1:63,360 outside the four upgraded regions; siting.source_accuracy.luc_overlay_m = 32 m is 0.5 mm at that scale, a cartographic convention and not an LRIS figure

name: Distance to grid data
source: LINZ Topo50 powerlines and road-centreline proxy; any layer carrying a voltage attribute is tiered
threshold: Per-voltage-tier nearest distances in metres; one implementation in grid_distance.verify_grid_flag flags on connection-tier distance against that tier's review_distance_m (grid_distance_review_m only where the layer carries no voltage attribute); unknown distance also flags; rank_shift is published but never triggers; excluded from screen_score
source_accuracy_basis: LINZ Topo50 and OSM line geometry; no accuracy band applied because the review distance is in kilometres, orders of magnitude above the disagreement between the layers

name: Mean annual solar radiation
threshold: Higher is better; weighted screen_score_weights.solar_resource in review ordering
source_accuracy_basis: LENZ mean annual solar radiation grid sampled per polygon; a raster value, no vector overlay

name: Mean slope
source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM sampled per site by scripts/compute_site_terrain.py
threshold: Mean slope over the polygon above maximum_mean_slope_deg; a site with no slope value is not excluded and raises S08_verify_slope instead
source_accuracy_basis: Copernicus GLO-30, a 30 m surface model; the rule uses the mean over the polygon rather than the maximum for that reason

name: Mapped water or wetland
threshold: Any intersection with mapped standing water or wetland
source_accuracy_basis: OpenStreetMap geometry, completeness and accuracy both uneven; distance is tested unrounded against zero

name: Coastal hazard proximity
threshold: Within coastal_review_distance_m of the open coast
source_accuracy_basis: OpenStreetMap coastline; the 1,000 m review distance is far above the layer's positional disagreement
